extracted.rawText:
The New York Times
Software Engineer, Reflections
10,001+ employees
Hybrid — New York, NY
Mid Level
About the team
You will report to the Engineering Manager. You will work with a cross-functional team including QA, design, product managers, native mobile, and data.
Responsibilities
Lead full-stack feature development from design to production
Collaborate with QA, design, PM, native mobile, and data partners
Participate in the team's on-call rotation
Ship reader-facing product improvements
Basic Qualifications
2+ years of experience owning features end-to-end from design through production
2+ years of experience unblocking teammates and driving technical decisions
2+ years of experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders
2+ years of professional experience with modern JavaScript technologies, including React, Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
2+ years of experience building backend services and working with technologies such as Go, Node.js/Express, GraphQL, and cloud platforms (GCP or AWS)
2+ years of experience working with data persistence technologies, including relational and/or document databases
2+ years of experience troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving issues in production environments
2+ years of experience collaborating with product, design, and QA partners
Preferred Qualifications
Experience using AI coding tools, especially for agentic workflows
Experience with DevOps practices, including CI/CD techniques and tooling (e.g. Drone, Jenkins), automated testing and deployments, observability and monitoring.
Familiarity with containers and container orchestration systems like Kubernetes, Docker.
Understanding of caching and content delivery.
